========================================================================
                 HUONG DAN CAI DAT VIET HOA: FLOTSAM
               Phien ban ho tro: v1.1.0f5  |  Ban dich: v1.0.0
            Thuc hien boi: Diiexe (https://github.com/diiexe)
   [MIEN PHI 100%] Neu ban phai tra tien mua ban dich nay la bi lua dao
========================================================================

1. CACH CAI DAT:
   - Buoc 1: Giai nen toan bo file Flotsam_VietHoa_v1.0.0.zip ra bat ky dau.
   - Buoc 2: Nhap dup chay file "Cai_Dat_Viet_Hoa.bat".
   - Buoc 3: Nhap phim "1" (hoac nhan Enter).
     + Neu script tu dong tim thay thu muc game Flotsam cua ban, chi can
       nhan Enter de cai dat ngay.
     + Neu ban cai game o vi tri khac, hay copy va dan duong dan thu muc
       game vao cua so CMD roi nhan Enter.
   - Buoc 4: Mo game va trai nghiem Tieng Viet!
     (Script da tu dong sao luu file goc vao Flotsam_Data\backup_goc
      va kich hoat san ngon ngu Tieng Viet).

2. CACH GO BO (KHOI PHUC GAME GOC 100%):
   - Cach 1: Chay file "Go_Cai_Dat.bat" va nhan Enter.
   - Cach 2: Chay file "Cai_Dat_Viet_Hoa.bat", chon "2" va nhan Enter.

3. TU CHINH SUA BAN DICH (DANH CHO NGUOI MUON SUA TEXT):
   - Truy cap kho ma nguon tren GitHub, sua file:
     src/vi_text/i2languages_vi.json
   - Chay lenh: python src/tools/build_patch.py

4. LUU Y:
   - Ban dich duoc thuc hien bang AI phuc vu nhu cau ca nhan, chia se
     cho ai can thi dung, dung duoc thi dung khong thi thoi nhe.
   - Ban mod chi them ngon ngu va font chu, chia se nguyen trang khong
     bao hanh; nguoi chia se khong chiu trach nhiem neu phat sinh loi
     game hay bat ky van de nao khac trong qua trinh su dung.
========================================================================
